name: Close
description: Close is a sales CRM with a REST API, OAuth apps, webhooks and an MCP server.
auth_notes: API keys are sent via HTTP Basic auth (key as username, empty password); OAuth 2.0 is used for user-facing integrations.
gate_detail: Developers create API keys in a Close account under Settings, Developer, API Keys, subject to role permissions (Manage own API keys). Whether a free plan or trial suffices is not stated in the sources.
api_scope: REST API with full endpoint docs, webhooks and a 30-day event log, plus OAuth app creation for integrations and an MCP server for AI agents.
mcp_notes: Developer docs list a Close MCP Server for AI agents; its URL is not given. Help-site MCP URL is for docs only.
blocker_detail: Requires a Close account and a role allowing API key creation; plan or trial requirements are not stated.
